next.prompt: Choose room palette: teal lantern (CR-70), the full RS-31 token set under data-room="choose" (plus --error), in the same calm family as Learn's Amber lantern. The backdrop (RS-34) re-tints from the tokens. Show it on Welcome, Survey and Gallery with the backdrop and glass, plus a token sheet.

nodes.title: Same night, teal lantern
nodes.direction: Only the lantern changes: Learn's navy walls, surfaces, lines, ink and code stay exactly; accent, lit light, glows, focus, path and the warm surface-2 turn teal. The two rooms read as one house with a different lamp.

nodes.title: Deep lagoon
nodes.direction: The whole room takes the hue: a blue-green night, teal-tinted surfaces and lines, cool white ink, a calmer sage-teal accent. Further from Learn, more its own place; same lightness steps as Learn so the calm holds.

nodes.title: Teal room, warm flame
nodes.direction: Teal is the room's colour (accent, settled nodes, paths, focus) but the lantern light itself stays a warm cream flame: lit nodes, their near glow and the motes are warm, the far glow teal. Slate-navy walls between Learn's and the lagoon's.
